{{Intro/Resonator|Aalto}}

He is an information broker from the [[New Federation]] and a Consultant of the [[Black Shores]].

==Official Introduction==
{{Quote|Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile.

Rumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.

He was invited to join the Black Shores, a mysterious organization based on an isolated island, for his intel-gathering expertise.

Both working for the Black Shores as Consultants, Aalto and Encore have become an inseparable and lively duo during missions.

Despite his skittish demeanor, Aalto's true character shines through as a reliable and attentive individual.|[https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com/en/main#resonators His introduction on the Official Website.]
}}

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/aalto#Finnish Aalto] is a Finnish word meaning "wave".
* Aalto’s Chinese name [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E7%A7%8B%E6%B0%B4 秋水] (qiūshuǐ) means "autumn water". It can also be used as an adjective for something clear or translucent.
